messages.subject: Re: Validating UI controls
parts:
Inside the reactive/output function, start off with
if(!is.numeric(input$submittedStuff))
return() # don't run further if this has characters
if(nchar(input$submittedStuff)==0)
return() # don't run further if it is empty

and in separate text output$warnings, you can use similar checks to see if it should display text warning of improper input, or return() and not show any warnings if it's all good.

That's how I went about similar issues.
